text_blocks.snippet: If you've been exposed to COVID-19, you should immediately start taking precautions to protect others. This includes wearing a high-quality mask or respirator, avoiding crowded places where you can't mask, and taking extra precautions if you're around people at higher risk for severe illness. You should also get tested at least 5 days after your last exposure, even if you don't have symptoms, and continue taking precautions through day 10, according to the CDC.
